findings.note: gl_PointSize scales by both uPointSize and uDevicePixelRatio; attenuation constant 300 amplifies at close range before clamp.
uPointSize is pre-scaled by window.devicePixelRatio (halved only for DPR >= 2), so shader multiply re-applies DPR.
ShaderMaterial primes uDevicePixelRatio with the renderer pixel ratio and refreshes it every resize; combined with DPR-aware point size this yields squared scaling.
Viewport width/height are derived from PerspectiveCamera Z (100) and canvas aspect; any camera shift or initial hint lag influences formation scaling inputs.
Single PerspectiveCamera is fixed at z=100 with fov 75; no dynamic dolly or scale compensation once particles overshoot.
Spawn volume ignores VC.VIEW_CAP_* and VC.Z_BACK_*; depth expands with viewport size and can exceed intended rush window.
Gaussian samples are unbounded; outer tiers and clusters can push many sigma beyond R, producing oversized 'ring' halos despite STARFIELD_SCALE nominally < 0.4 of frame.
Directive pointSize oscillates between base (≈48) and base*VC.POINT_SIZE_KICK (≈67.2); with shader DPR multiplication this yields 90–130px sprites on DPR=2 displays.

findings.note: Depth and view caps defined here are never consumed in generateViewportSpread/ConstellationFormation, so spawn volume always depends on live viewport math.
Quality atom computes targetDpr per tier but WebGLCanvas never applies it to the renderer, so high-DPR devices keep full pixel ratio, compounding point size growth.

CE: Clamp gaussian samples in generateConstellationFormation (lines 587-629) to |gauss| ≤ 1.2 before scaling so extents stay within ~0.6·min(view), then renormalize clusters.
Lower VC.STARFIELD_SCALE (visual-controls.js:19) into 0.60–0.66 and VC.T2_CLUSTER_SIGMA (line 38) into 0.12–0.14 to keep every tier ≤0.82·min(viewWidth,viewHeight).
Use VC.VIEW_CAP_HALF_W/H when viewportHint is missing and bound generateViewportSpread (lines 555-567) to those caps instead of raw width/height.
Replace zDepth = max(width,height)*0.3 (line 561) with interpolation between VC.Z_BACK_MIN/MAX for consistent rush depth regardless of viewport.
Emit final RENDER_DIRECTIVE pointSize = base after settle (line 249) and cap incoming overrides to base..base*VC.POINT_SIZE_KICK before sending.
WBG: Stop pre-scaling uPointSize by window.devicePixelRatio (lines 64-70); keep base size and rely on shader’s uDevicePixelRatio multiplier for a single source of truth.
Clamp uDevicePixelRatio updates to e.g. Math.min(gl.getPixelRatio(), 1.5) in the resize hook (line 290) so directives don’t explode on 4K/HiDPI.
Log/guard RENDER_DIRECTIVE pointSize overrides (line 329) to ensure they respect the new base range before marking mat.needsUpdate.
Emit viewport hints once per warm-up and on explicit resize only (lines 73-105) to reduce jitter when extents are near the edge.
Expose a dev probe (via window.__webglBackground) that reports combined uPointSize·uDevicePixelRatio so sizing regression is easy to verify.
Canvas: Pass a bounded DPR to <Canvas> (line 338), e.g. dpr={Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1.5)}, so renderer pixel ratio matches the clamp used in WBG.
